body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Sony is expecting to release world's first OLED TV'XEL-1’ on December 1, 2007 in Japan market.
It features 11-inch OLED display with a resolution of 960*540, a contrast ratio rate of 1,000,000:1, and adopted its own technology STE(Super Top Emission).
(Picture: Sony displayed its OLED TV during the last CES 2007 in Las Vegas, USA)
